title: Thinking Machines Lab signs multibillion-dollar Google Cloud deal for Nvidia GB300 chips

sources.quote: Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab has signed a new multi-billion-dollar agreement with Google Cloud for AI infrastructure built on Nvidia's latest GB300 chips, Google announced Wednesday at its Cloud Next conference in Las Vegas.
For Thinking Machines Lab, the agreement marks its first formal partnership with a cloud provider, although it has previously collaborated with Nvidia.

explain: Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab agreed to rent Nvidia GB300-based computing from Google Cloud to train and run its models. Google called it multibillion-dollar; a source told TechCrunch it is in the single-digit billions, but no exact figure was given.
